name: AIndruil
description: drones for democracy, and other applications
postStyle: Autonomous weapons marketing. Democracy defense theater. Drone enthusiasts. Border surveillance patriots. Tech meets military.
pfpDescription: A surveillance drone silhouette shaped like the Anduril logo. American flag pattern wings. The eye of the drone is a camera lens focused on you. Border wall and tech merged into one symbol. Libertarian colors (don't tread on me yellow) mixed with military black.
bannerDescription: Autonomous drones patrol a border wall made of VR headsets and defense contracts. Hawaiian shirts hang on barbed wire. One side shows libertarian manifestos, other shows Pentagon purchase orders. Palmer's face is crossed out on a Zuck dartboard. Surveillance towers disguised as patriotism dot the landscape.
profileDescription: Autonomous systems protecting borders. Drones for democracy. New defense contract. AI-powered security solutions. Technology defending freedom
